vulnerablePath: PATCH /rest/v1/profiles?id=eq.<own id> with the caller's own token and body { credits: 1000000 }
policy "profiles: update own" allows the update: USING (id = auth.uid()), no WITH CHECK, default UPDATE privilege on every column
POST /api/invoices/export and public.spend_export_credit() read profiles.credits: paid exports without paying
expectedSecureBehavior: A signed-in user can edit their display name but never their credits; exports stop at zero credits.
acceptableFixes: Revoke UPDATE on profiles from authenticated and grant back only the columns users may edit
WITH CHECK that keeps credits equal to the stored value, plus the same for INSERT
Move credits to a table only the service role and SECURITY DEFINER functions write
A BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE trigger that raises when credits change for a non-service caller
unacceptableFixes: Checking the credits only in the API route while PostgREST still accepts the update
A column-level REVOKE UPDATE (credits) while the table-level UPDATE privilege stays
A CHECK constraint on credits (a user still picks any value inside it)
